extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF/OA package evidence; no molecular target claim is overpromoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports phenotypic antifungal, antibacterial, cytotoxicity, and antibiofilm activity for DK5/CAR-PEG-DK5 derivatives through MIC, IC50, BIC50, and BEC50 tables.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic activity tables do not identify a single molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ITC and membrane-model sections support membrane interaction context for selected lipopeptides, including POPG/POPC LUV binding and thermodynamic parameters for C12-DK5 and C12-CAR-PEG-DK5.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model-membrane binding evidence is not converted into a direct cellular killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Molecular dynamics figures support membrane-binding and self-assembly context for C12-CAR-PEG-DK5 relative to C5-DK5/C12-DK5.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Simulation evidence is retained as computational context and not treated as direct mechanism proof.
